summary: Open-source, local-first alternative to ElevenLabs for AI voice cloning, dubbing, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages.
usecases: Local voice cloning for privacy-sensitive applications
Programmatic video dubbing and multilingual content localization
Offline text-to-speech and transcription workflows for content creators
ideas: Integrate with local LLMs for interactive AI assistants with custom voices
Build a desktop app for generating audiobooks from text files using cloned voices
Combine with speech-to-text pipelines for real-time multilingual conversation translation
